jobs.title: Copywriter
jobs.description: As a Copywriter (m/w/d), you will own the words behind PERGOLUX campaigns across our global markets, writing and editing copy for Meta, Google, email, and web that turns product benefits into clear, persuasive messaging. You will shape headlines, product descriptions, campaign concepts, and calls to action, adapting tone and messaging for different audiences, languages, and cultural contexts while keeping brand voice consistent. Working closely with marketing, product, e-commerce, and sales colleagues, you will drive copy quality from first draft through hands-on editing and testing. PERGOLUX designs and sells Scandinavian-inspired outdoor living products, from pergolas to garden furniture, directly to consumers. We are a company that has grown consistently across Europe and beyond, with around 300 employees, 9-figure revenue, and operations spanning 8 markets. What You'll Do - Write and edit copy for Meta, Google, email, web, and other marketing channels, developing compelling headlines, product descriptions, and calls to action. - Optimise copy for Meta and Google campaigns, testing different messaging angles and calls to action to improve campaign performance. - Support the product page redesign process with clear, conversion-focused copy that communicates key benefits and improves the user experience. - Adapt messaging across multiple markets, languages, and cultural nuances while keeping brand voice and tone consistent through hands-on quality checks. - Collaborate with global and local teams across marketing, product, e-commerce, and sales to deliver effective, on-brand communication. What You'll Bring - 5+ years of copywriting experience with a strong portfolio of high-quality work for digital marketing channels, including paid ads, email, web, and social media. - Excellent writing, editing, and proofreading skills in English, with a strong eye for detail, accuracy, and consistency. - A solid grasp of brand voice, storytelling, and persuasive messaging, plus

jobs.title: Initiativbewerbung Werkstudent:in Softwareentwicklung (m/w/d) - Karlsruhe
jobs.description: Wir bei Knuddels haben uns das Ziel gesetzt, soziale Netzwerke wieder wirklich sozial zu machen - mit echter menschlicher Nähe statt bloßen Content-Konsums. In unserer Community soll jedes Mitglied 3 wichtige Menschen für sein echtes Leben finden: Jobtitel sind dir nicht wichtig und du möchtest dazu beitragen, unsere Vision zu erreichen? Wir wollen dich kennenlernen. Du bist der Ansicht, du könntest gut zu unserem Unternehmen und in unser Team passen? Dann bewirb dich mit deinen Unterlagen und wir finden gemeinsam heraus, wie und wo wir dich am besten einsetzen können. Was bieten wir dir? Wachstum nach deinen Vorstellungen - Ob Fach- oder Führungskarriere: bei uns gestaltest du deinen individuellen Entwicklungspfad mit. Team-Unterstützung durch Gespräche, Coaching, Feedback und Mentoring - Wir leben eine offene Kultur mit ehrlichem, konstruktivem Austausch und starkem Zusammenhalt. Flache Hierarchien und Mitsprache - Bei uns zählt jede Stimme: gestalte aktiv mit und bring deine Ideen ein. Flexibilität, die sich deinem Leben anpasst - Home Office, spontane Arzttermine oder kurzfristiger Urlaub: wir vertrauen auf Selbstorganisation. Büro in Top-Lage mit kostenlosem Frühstück und Mittagessen, Fitness, Mystery Lunch (zweiwöchentliches Mittagessen mit einem zufälligen Teammitglied), Workshops und wunderschöner Dachterrasse - Unsere Arbeitsumgebung bietet alles für Wohlbefinden und kreative Energie. Direktes Feedback von Endnutzern (B2C-Company) - Du siehst unmittelbar, wie dein Beitrag bei unseren Nutzer:innen ankommt. Fokus auf unser eigenes Produkt - Eine einzigartige Community-Plattform, die Menschen näher zusammenbringt, mit Sinn und Wirkung. alle Benefits findest auch nochmal unter jobs.knuddels.de Was bieten wir nicht? Staubige Konzernstrukturen Arbeiten an Geschäftskundenprojekten (Wir sind ein B2C-Unternehmen) Einen an den Haaren herbei gezogenen dritten Bullet Point, wenn uns nur zwei einfallen :) Du befindest dich mind. im 3. Semester in Informatik, Mathematik

jobs.title: Meewerkstage Content Creation: Video & Fotografie
jobs.description: Wat ga je doen? Bij Voortman gebeurt elke dag iets dat het waard is om vast te leggen. Van indrukwekkende staalbewerkingsmachines en nieuwe technologieën tot de mensen en verhalen achter onze internationale organisatie. Als stagiair Content Creation ga jij die verhalen zichtbaar maken. Je gaat zelfstandig en samen met collega’s aan de slag met video, fotografie en creatieve contentformats. De ene dag film je in onze productieomgeving, de andere dag maak je portretten van collega’s of werk je aan een videoserie voor onze socialmediakanalen of interne communicatie. Daarbij zijn we ook benieuwd naar jouw ideeën. Welke trends, formats en technieken moeten we volgens jou uitproberen? Je krijgt volop ruimte om te experimenteren en jouw creatieve blik in te brengen. Je komt terecht in een Marketing & Communicatieteam met specialisten op het gebied van foto- en videografie, content, design, communicatie en online marketing. Je leert van ervaren collega’s, maar krijgt ook de vrijheid om zelf ideeën uit te werken en producties van begin tot eind op te pakken. En aan onderwerpen geen gebrek. Op onze Voortman Campus in Rijssen vind je productie, assemblage, R&D en ons Experience Center dicht bij elkaar. Tegelijkertijd werken we met collega’s over de hele wereld. Concreet ga je onder andere: Video’s bedenken, filmen en editen voor social media, employer branding en interne en commerciële communicatie; Fotografie verzorgen van collega’s, machines, projecten en evenementen; Nieuwe contentformats ontwikkelen en experimenteren met trends, storytelling en AI-tools; Verhalen ophalen binnen de organisatie en vertalen naar aansprekende visuele content; Content geschikt maken voor verschillende kanalen en doelgroepen, van Instagram en LinkedIn tot ons interne platform. jobs.title: Junior Copywriter
jobs.description: Not all heroes wear capes – but plenty of them use toilet paper Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion! Funny name, serious business We are a leading planet-conscious household essentials business and we donate 50% of our profits to help everyone gain access to clean water and a toilet. As of June 2026, we've contributed over $20 million AUD to this mission. Basically, we're really good at making it easy to do good. We operate scaling businesses in the UK, US, Australia and Canada. Our 250+ people aim to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next 5-10 years, we're hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services. A bit about the role We're looking for a Junior Copywriter based remotely in the Philippines to join our creative team and dig into the world of growth and paid advertising. This is a role for someone who loves writing, is curious about what makes an ad actually work and wants to get hands-on with briefs that are driven by real performance data. You'll be writing scripts and copy for paid social (still and video), collaborating with our local creative strategists and video team, and doing the kind of fast-paced, purposeful work that puts more planet-conscious toilet paper in the world. Which is, it turns out, a great thing to put in the world. The rate of pay is $20 per 100 words (this comes out to approximately $100 per article or $50 per hour). Some topics you may be asked to write about include the following (you can always turn down a topic if you do not feel comfortable writing about it, however if you have experience or expertise in a specific area, please let us know): Health & beauty Fitness Home Decor Fashion Sports Do it yourself Finance Legal Medical Family/Parenting Relationships Real Estate Restaurants Contracting (plumbing, pool building, remodeling, etc.) These are just some of the more general industries and topics that we cover. Requirements : We ask that all work be completed using a word processor such as Microsoft Word or Open Office A reliable internet connection and the ability to meet deadlines Good communication skills and respond in a timely manner to editorial staff when they ask for updates on tasks, etc Work well as a team member with the rest of our content management and editorial staff Note : Applicants to this job signaled that accessing some writing tasks may require payment.

jobs.title: Content Reviewer - United States
jobs.description: We are looking for an independent, flexible, remote opportunity where you can help improve AI-powered search technology from the comfort of your home? If you're curious, internet-savvy, and enjoy evaluating online content, this freelance project could be a great fit. A Day in the Life of a Content Reviewer - US In this role, you will analyze and provide feedback on text, webpages, images, and other types of online content for leading search engines using a specialized online platform. By reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you will help improve the overall search experience for millions of users around the world, including yourself. Join our global community and put your skills to work supporting one of the world's leading search technologies. Service Rates The rate of pay is $0.2333 per completed task, with an estimated earning potential of $14 per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines. Please note that only one member per household may participate in this program. If it is identified that more than one person from the same household is participating in the TELUS Digital Rating Program, all associated accounts may be removed from the program. Independent Contractor Relationship This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital. Qualification path Qualification Process No previous professional experience is required to apply for this opportunity. However, participation in this project requires meeting the basic requirements and successfully completing the qualification process
